description: SmartData 2026 年 7 月 SQLite 销售标准问答契约

cases.question: orders 的总记录数是多少？
cases.verification_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM orders

cases.question: orders 中 total_amount 的总额
cases.verification_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS total_total_amount FROM orders

cases.question: orders 中 total_amount 的平均值
cases.verification_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_amount), 2) AS average_total_amount FROM orders

cases.question: orders 中 total_amount 最高的前 5 条记录
cases.verification_sql: SELECT order_no, ROUND(total_amount, 2) AS total_amount FROM orders ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: orders 中 total_amount 的最大值
cases.verification_sql: SELECT ROUND(MAX(total_amount), 2) AS max_total_amount FROM orders

cases.question: orders 中 total_amount 的最小值
cases.verification_sql: SELECT ROUND(MIN(total_amount), 2) AS min_total_amount FROM orders

cases.question: 2026 年 7 月已完成的订单有多少笔？
cases.verification_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND order_date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31'

cases.question: 2026 年 7 月已完成订单的销售总额是多少？
cases.verification_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS total_total_amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed'

cases.question: 2026 年 7 月 1 日到 5 日每天已完成订单的销售额是多少？
cases.verification_sql: SELECT order_date, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS total_amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND order_date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-05' GROUP BY order_date ORDER BY order_date

cases.question: 已完成订单按商品分类统计销售额，哪个分类最高？
cases.verification_sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(i.line_amount), 2) AS total_amount FROM order_items AS i JOIN products AS p ON p.id = i.product_id JOIN orders AS o ON o.id = i.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY total_amount DESC

cases.question: 各地区已完成订单的销售额分别是多少？
cases.verification_sql: SELECT c.region, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) AS total_amount FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY total_amount DESC

cases.question: 已完成订单中销量最高的 5 个商品是什么？
cases.verification_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(i.quantity) AS quantity FROM order_items AS i JOIN products AS p ON p.id = i.product_id JOIN orders AS o ON o.id = i.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY quantity DESC, p.name LIMIT 5
